name: Berkeley November Weekday Favorites 2026

venue.name: SOCS 20
venue.details: This venue is NOT the normal Pauley Ballroom venue!

information: ## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend. ## This competition is also a favorites competition. Please read the Favorites Competition Format tab before registering. You are only able to register for a limited number of the events available at this competition ## This competition will run in 2 groups. You will compete in one group and run, judge, or scramble for the other group. You MUST be present for the entirety of both groups (i.e. 6-9pm), otherwise you will not be allowed to compete. * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. - Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.
